In detail

Leicestershire Police recorded 297 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — 5.7 per 1,000 residents, the 18th highest rate of Leicester's 21 wards. The daytime score here is driven by vehicle crime (7), shoplifting (6), burglary (3); the evening/night score by violent crime (34), anti social behaviour (18), public order (11). Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.

Frequently asked questions

Is Rushey Mead safe?

Wandroz currently rates Rushey Mead in Leicester as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Leicester during the day and relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Leicester at night. This rating is derived from Leicestershire Police street-level crime records published at data.police.uk — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats.

At night, Rushey Mead is rated as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Leicester. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.
